## What this region is

The commands that deliver the Prisma schema to a database-client / data-modeling and move data between databases (scripts/db/), and the seed system that loads production-safe and prime development data through the hook-aware seed runner.

## What it exists for

- Get a schema change into a database
- Move, reset or seed database data
- Fill a database with seed or test data

## When this is not your domain

These mention this region's words but belong elsewhere; the answer is no, and the region named answers instead.

- What do I call the two ends of this relation → conventions
- Make these writes behave correctly around a transaction → database-client
- Declare or read which kinds a model can point at → data-modeling
- How do I test this route → test-harness
- Build a test user with sensible defaults → test-factories-rules
